evidence.detail: The class is a pure static holder: one boolean mode flag, one alternate rs/v[] model-header/cache array, and one alternate rs/k[][] animation-frame/cache matrix, with only trivial getters and setters.
The model subsystem allocates the alternate rs/v[] array separately from its ordinary model-header array and selects between them through this class whenever the OSRS mode flag is active.

The animation/frame subsystem allocates an alternate rs/k[][] matrix, selects it through this class when OSRS mode is active, and contains surviving OSRS animation paths/diagnostics such as old_osrs_anims and 'Could not find OSRS animation file'.
Multiple definition/model/animation call sites save or set the mode flag around OSRS-specific lookups and restore it afterward, while OnDemandFetcher tags requests from the same active mode.

proposals.note: OsrsAssetState is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for the static OSRS mode plus alternate model/animation asset state. No surviving original source noun was found, so confidence is 0.996.
